team_name: United States Men's National Soccer Team

head_coach.name: Mauricio Pochettino
head_coach.play_style_summary: Attack-minded and possession-based style. Aims to dominate the game, retain possession close to the opposition's goal, press high up the pitch, and transition quickly.

key_players.name: Christian Pulisic
key_players.performance_stats: Serving as AC Milan's biggest star, recording elite goal involvement numbers and displaying spectacular form in Serie A.

key_players.name: Weston McKennie
key_players.performance_stats: A key creative force for Juventus, providing 15 assists in 38 appearances across all competitions while securing a long-term contract extension.

key_players.name: Folarin Balogun
key_players.performance_stats: Showing highly dangerous striker form for AS Monaco in Ligue 1, demonstrating consistent and clinical attacking threat.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Torn ligaments in his left ankle suffered during a match with Crystal Palace, casting heavy doubt on his fitness.
Recovering from ankle surgery following an injury setback suffered with his club team.
Dealing with a muscle injury sustained with Lyon at the end of the club season, which ultimately led to his omission from the national squad.
